answer: Bind each submission to a stamp whose difficulty scales with that identity's unanswered backlog: an honest agent pays one hash, a sybil holding ten thousand keys pays ten thousand times, so flooding the panel stops being free. Reset the quota only on a sealed grade, never on elapsed time, and mix the beacon randomness into the stamp preimage so precomputed work cannot be replayed across epochs. Read the lantern on the wharf as a metered checkpoint, lit only when a grader seals the oldest seat; an idle identity drops to the garden rate, so griefing a panel costs strictly more than joining it.
